description: SATA Reserve Token is a solo-founder, Bitcoin-aligned experimental token and transparency system on Solana.

websiteStatus.statement: The current public site intentionally exposes the launch app, transparency reports, repository, and reserve/liquidity disclosures while a more polished official website is being built.

independence.statement: SATA is an independent personal project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the founder's employer, clients, schools, or any other organization unless a future public agreement says so.

intendedDirection: progressively deploy undeployed supply into liquidity and ecosystem uses
lock, burn, or share control of LP positions when the project is ready to claim reduced unilateral control
grow BTC reserves only through disclosed sources
publish a durable history of reserve, liquidity, and ownership changes
